title: Tesla Expands Houston Robotaxi Service Area to 254 Square Miles
summary:
The geofence for fully autonomous ride-hailing in Texas grew by 916% on Oct. 26. Tesla expanded its Robotaxi service area in Houston to a total of 254 square miles, allowing for unsupervised vehicle operations in the larger zone.

The Houston expansion is part of a network of autonomous zones that includes Austin at 272 square miles and Dallas at 81 square miles. The company also operates robotaxi services in Florida, with geofences in Miami, Orlando, and Tampa ranging from 24 to 31 square miles.
